_README: Commissioner rulings. Anything here beats the auto-computed result. Keyed by season -> week -> username.

_rulings.late_lineup: Late lineup accepted. Requires "points". Use for a 1st offense free pass.
_rulings.fine_paid: $25 paid, late lineup counts. Requires "points". Fine is added to their ledger.
_rulings.league_low: Force the week's lowest league score. This is already the automatic default for a no-show, so you rarely need it.
_rulings.score: Manually set a score for any reason. Requires "points".
